question: In a certain code language, ‘HONOR’ is coded as 16-30-28-30-36 and ‘PLEAD’ is coded as 32-24-10-2-8. How will ‘LOCK’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘HONOR’ is coded as 16-30-28-30-36

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a3abe93114f291a616f0d31e01454ff38f45a8f3ed28e331fbcdd5eed53342.png] 

And,

‘PLEAD’ is coded as 32-24-10-2-8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d00a84c1faa42e988b96df04d59f369f6c74ab82137052510fe263b453c00987.png] 

Similarly,

‘LOCK’ is coded as 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4a15937939772d7bd53a62a7f5110504de0e57a545a6899f3e9ac38ffe0122f.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
